=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py:ISSUE_REF_RE at line ~60 (regex definition), _extract_referenced_issues at line ~120 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: ISSUE_REF_RE only matches the short `#N` form and does not match full GitHub issue URLs.
  WHY: A PR body that references the tracking issue solely via full URL can bypass `_extract_referenced_issues`, so the archival lint never inspects that issue.
- scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py:CHECKBOX_RE at line ~65 (`r"^\s*-\s*\[(?P<state>[ xX])\]\s+(?P<text>.+)$"`) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: CHECKBOX_RE requires trailing text after `[ ]`, so bare checkbox items like `- [ ]` are not matched.
  WHY: The readiness check counts blank checkboxes as unchecked, but the archival lint would see none and allow archive completion to pass.
- scripts/check_integration_pr_readiness.py:59-73 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: All failure modes in `_fetch_issue` collapse to a single `None` return value.
  WHY: A transient GitHub API outage or rate-limit event makes the workflow post an `error` status and fail the step instead of treating readiness as temporarily unassessable.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
